assets.description: One single short persimmon-orange rectangular paper kite tail tab, shape like a neat small rectangle with one clipped corner; face up, no folds, strong solid color, no strings. Use a very compact horizontal silhouette so its silhouette reads as exactly one piece when repeated at tiny size.

One single short turquoise-green rectangular paper kite tail tab, the same horizontal dimensions and clipped-corner shape as the orange paper tab; face up, no folds, no strings. Strong solid contrasting mint turquoise tone, reads as exactly one piece when repeated.

One small friendly mustard-yellow wooden wheeled craft trolley, three-quarter top-down view, chunky toy wheels, pale green empty tray, no person, facing right, easy to recognize and navigate with as a small game token.
The same mustard-yellow empty wooden craft trolley facing right, both chunky wheels turned a little as if rolling; same size, colors and three-quarter top-down viewing angle as above. No speed lines.
One tiny bright apricot diamond kite with a short pine green tail and one cream leaf motif, inset into a thick cream cut-paper sticker silhouette; no text, no shadow outside the sticker.

One single finished cream diamond-shaped bamboo kite with orange flower, pine green leaf decorations and one gently curved persimmon tail, compact square overall silhouette. No frame and no other objects. Children's gouache craft illustration.
